queries.sql:
WITH plan_data AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(m.plan_account_code, p.account_code) AS account_code, p.period, SUM(p.amount) AS plan_amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED p
        LEFT JOIN SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.MAP_GL_TO_PLAN m ON p.account_code = m.gl_account_code
        WHERE p.version_id = 2
          AND p.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-12'
          
        GROUP BY COALESCE(m.plan_account_code, p.account_code), p.period
      ),
      actual_data AS (
        SELECT a.plan_account_code AS account_code, a.period, SUM(a.mapped_amount) AS actual_amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_MAPPED_ACTUALS a
        WHERE a.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-12'
          
        GROUP BY a.plan_account_code, a.period
      ),
      combined AS (
        SELECT
          COALESCE(p.account_code, a.account_code) AS account_code,
          COALESCE(p.period, a.period) AS period,
          COALESCE(a.actual_amount, 0) AS actual_amount,
          COALESCE(p.plan_amount, 0) AS plan_amount
        FROM plan_data p
        FULL OUTER JOIN actual_data a
          ON p.account_code = a.account_code AND p.period = a.period
      ),
      account_labels AS (
        SELECT account_code, account_name, sort_order
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT
        WHERE account_code IN ('rev-gross','rev-ded','cogs-mat','cogs-lab','cogs-oh','opex-sm','opex-rd','opex-ga','nonop-ii','nonop-ie','nonop-oth','tax','da-plants','da-facilities','da-tech')
      )
      SELECT
        c.account_code,
        COALESCE(al.account_name, c.account_code) AS account_name,
        COALESCE(al.sort_order, 999) AS sort_order,
        c.period,
        c.actual_amount,
        c.plan_amount
      FROM combined c
      LEFT JOIN account_labels al ON c.account_code = al.account_code
      WHERE c.account_code IN ('rev-gross','rev-ded','cogs-mat','cogs-lab','cogs-oh','opex-sm','opex-rd','opex-ga','nonop-ii','nonop-ie','nonop-oth','tax','da-plants','da-facilities','da-tech')
      ORDER BY c.account_code, c.period
